summary: Landwirtschaftliche Rentenbank, a German federal agency, filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a $1,000,000,000 offering of 5.000% notes due 2036. The notes price at 99.495% of par, with a 0.175% underwriting discount, yielding $993.2 million in proceeds to the issuer. Interest is payable March 22 and September 22, with settlement expected September 22, 2026. The notes carry a statutory guarantee of the Federal Republic of Germany, are non-redeemable except for tax-law changes, and will be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. Underwriters include Banco Santander, J.P. Morgan, Nomura and Societe Generale. This is a routine debt takedown, not a special situation.
